title: Playwright proves the home pitch is spoken-length audio
description:
## Behavior

```gherkin
Feature: The home page demonstrates narration on itself
  Scenario: Ready home audio is spoken-length
    Given the home page embed has posted the Kokoro pitch
    When the player has a playable clip
    Then audio duration is at least twenty seconds
```

Tone stubs are far shorter. This keeps CI from treating a 440 Hz beep as a working demo.

## Implementation brief

1. Extend `site/tests/acceptance.spec.ts` landing test to wait for enabled Play and assert `audio.duration >= 20`.
2. Do not enable PyPI.
right_now_summary: The landing test is being updated to require a playable home clip lasting at least 20 seconds.
